sloka: केतुमूर्धनि गृध्रो ऽस्य निलीनो दक्षिणामुखः ।तुदन्नुभयतः पार्श्वं समग्रामहरत् प्रभाम् ।। ६.५७.३९ ।।।।
transliteration: ketumūrdhani gṛdhro 'sya nilīno dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ।tudannubhayataḥ pārśvaṁ samagrāmaharat prabhām ।। 6.57.39 ।।।।

translations.english: Seeing a vulture sitting on the banner (of Prahastha) facing south scratching both sides, Prahastha became pale as if the entire prosperity had been snatched away.
